blocks.text: WASHINGTON — Beijing is building nuclear weapons at a “hot and heavy” pace, President Donald Trump said Friday, a day after he met Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin and the three countries agreed to talks on preventing nuclear proliferation. While Russia and the U.S. lead the world by each possessing thousands of nuclear weapons, China is rapidly expanding its nuclear arsenal. In its annual review of China’s military buildup, the Pentagon said China’s stockpile of nuclear warheads remained in the low 600s through 2024, but the country was on track to have more than 1,000 warheads by […]...
